title: The Bean Jar on the Top Step
youtube_title: The Bean Jar on the Top Step | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A slow finish can be the right finish.
summary: At a ceramic studio table where slip and handles must set, Kira wants to check on a bean jar wrapped in a damp cloth on the top step before it is ready. With Nana Ruth nearby, Kira leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
